caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow plate or dish with a decorative floral motif in the center. The border of the plate is outlined in a reddish-brown color with a beaded texture. Inside the plate, there is a symmetrical arrangement of stylized flowers and leaves, primarily in shades of brown, orange, and yellow, with green accents. The central flower is larger and positioned upright, while two smaller, similarly styled flowers flank it on either side, along with additional curved leaves and stems. The background of the plate is a light yellowish-tan, and the rest of the drawing outside the plate is an unadorned, off-white color. The floral forms are curvilinear and ornate, filling the interior space of the plate.
title: Pa. German Pie Dish
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
